newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-SCORES FROM THE LAST-DAY SINGLES IN THE PRESIDENTS CUP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-SCORES FROM THE LAST-DAY SINGLES IN THE PRESIDENTS CUP.

text.p: Final-day scores
from the singles matches in the Presidents Cup, won on Sunday
by the United States 16 1/2 to 15 1/2 over the International
team:
United States 16 1/2 International team 15 1/2
Singles results:
Craig Parry (International) beat Mark Brooks (U.S.) 5 and 4
David Duval (U.S.) beat Peter Senior (International) 3 and 2
Mark O'Meara (U.S.) beat Nick Price (International) 1 up
David Frost (International) beat Kenny Perry (U.S.) 7 and 6
Steve Stricker (U.S.) beat Robert Allenby (International) 6
and 5
Scott Hoch (U.S.) beat Mark McNulty (International) 1 up
Davis Love (U.S.) beat Masashi "Jumbo" Ozaki (International)
5 and 4
Steve Elkington (International) beat Justin Leonard (U.S.) 1
up
Ernie Els (International) beat Phil Mickelson (U.S.) 3 and 2
Greg Norman (International) beat Corey Pavin (U.S.) 3 and 1
Frank Nobilo (International) beat Tom Lehman (U.S.) 3 and 2
Fred Couples (U.S.) beat Vijay Singh (International) 2 and 1
The United States retain the Cup by one point at Robert
Trent Jones Golf Club in the second staging of the event.
